Alpha Merit Scholarship for Girls 2026-27

The scholarship is offered by the Department of Test Education to meritorious girl students.

Eligibility

  • Only girl students admitted to the first year of an undergraduate degree course are eligible.
  • Applicants must have scored at least 75% marks in Class 12.
  • Annual family income should not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 from all sources.

Benefits

Scholarship of Rs. 50,000 per annum for up to four years.

Important Dates

Last date for online application by students: 31-08-2026

Documents Required

  • Class 12 marksheet
  • Income certificate
  • Aadhaar card
